requirements.title: IMU Sample Rate
requirements.description: The IMU library shall produce IMU samples at 200 Hz during the mission.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-005: PM-fixed 200 Hz IMU rate to bound boost-phase motion and support nav at 100 Hz.

requirements.title: Accelerometer Range Configuration
requirements.description: The IMU library shall configure the accelerometer range to plus or minus 16 G.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-006: flight envelope reaches 13 G; 16 G range provides margin without saturation during boost.

requirements.title: Gyroscope Range Configuration
requirements.description: The IMU library shall configure the gyroscope range to plus or minus 2000 degrees per second.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-007: maximum rotation rate envelope for FT1; 2000 dps avoids saturation during boost and recovery.

requirements.title: Accelerometer Output Units
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report accelerometer measurements in meters per second squared.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-042: PM decision to use SI units globally to eliminate unit-conversion ambiguity.

requirements.title: Gyroscope Output Units
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report gyroscope measurements in radians per second.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-042: PM decision to use SI units globally to eliminate unit-conversion ambiguity.

requirements.title: Per-Sample Timestamp
requirements.description: The IMU library shall include a timestamp on every IMU sample it produces.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-027: PM decision that per-sample timestamps are required for accurate post-flight nav reconstruction.

requirements.title: Body-Frame Measurement Convention
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report measurements in the body frame with X-forward, Y-right, Z-down axes.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-057: PM-defined aerospace-standard body axis convention for FT1 nav and telemetry.

requirements.title: Power-On Self-Test Probe
requirements.description: The IMU library shall probe the IMU device once at startup and report a pass-or-fail result.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-029: PM-required POST so the operator knows pre-flight whether the IMU is responsive.

requirements.title: Continuous Health Reporting
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report IMU device health continuously throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-031: PM-required ongoing health observability for inclusion in telemetry and logging.

requirements.title: Unhealthy on Read Failure
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report the IMU as unhealthy when a sample read fails.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-058: PM decision that failed sensors are flagged unhealthy in the published health state.

requirements.title: Unhealthy on POST Failure
requirements.description: The IMU library shall report the IMU as unhealthy when the startup probe fails.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-029 and SW-REQ-SYS-031: a failed POST must be reflected in continuous health reporting.

requirements.title: Continuation After Read Failure
requirements.description: The IMU library shall continue operating after an IMU sample read fails.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-033: PM decision to never halt mission on sensor failure; continue execution.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Equivalence
requirements.description: The IMU library shall provide functionally equivalent POSIX and Pico2 implementations.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-043: PM-required so Trick simulation exercises the same software paths as flight.

requirements.title: Deterministic Outputs
requirements.description: The IMU library shall produce deterministic outputs given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-044: PM-required determinism for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
